name: Bean and Nopales Huaraches

ingredients.name: vegetarian fresh white cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Mix masa harina with salt, then gradually knead in 390 ml warm water until the dough is soft, cohesive and free of large cracks. Reserve 20 ml water for adjusting if dry. Cover and rest 15 minutes. Mash the cooked beans into a thick, spreadable paste; drain the cooked nopales well so their surface is not slippery.

Divide the dough into four equal portions. Roll each portion into a long oval, roughly 20 × 9 cm and about 1 cm thick, between two sheets of plastic or baking paper. Smooth cracked edges with a damp finger. Keep the sandal-like shape long and narrow; a round disc would resemble a sope instead.

Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat and cook each masa oval for 5–6 minutes per side until browned in spots and cooked through. Brush the bases with 15 ml oil in total and return them to the griddle for another 1 minute per side to make the outside lightly crisp while the centre stays tender.

Heat the remaining 10 ml oil in a pan and sauté the drained nopales for 3–4 minutes until hot and any surface liquid evaporates. Warm the mashed pinto beans separately. Check that the cheese is made with vegetarian coagulants. Chop the white onion and coriander finely.

Spread about 90 g warm mashed beans over each hot long oval, leaving a visible border. Divide the cooked nopales, thick red salsa, crumbled vegetarian cheese, onion, coriander and crema among the four. Serve immediately, one huarache per person, while the masa remains warm and sturdy enough to hold the toppings.
tips: Use already cooked, drained nopales; raw cactus needs cleaning and a separate cooking step. The reviewed photo shows two unusually long, narrow corn bases under beans, green nopales, red salsa, white cheese and crema, visually distinct from round sopes and small chalupas.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
